description: Read the transcript of one call answered by a line you own, with a signed listen link when stored/provider data indicates a recording. Use a line_id from get_answering_line and call_id from get_line_calls; both the line and the call must belong to this owner. Returns status, transcript text, speaker turns, summary and listen_url/listen_expires_at. Calls still being processed and recordings known to be unavailable have no link; the listen endpoint checks actual audio availability. The private link expires after 15 minutes and needs no login: do not publish it. No raw provider recording URL is returned. For a message list use get_line_messages; for call history use get_line_calls. Needs lines:manage; rate limited per account; changes no line settings.

call_id.description: The exact call id from get_line_calls on this line.

name: get_line_call_transcript
title: Read one answering-line call transcript
